correctness.rationale: At equilibrium the delay disappears. Positivity gives X_S>d2/beta; monotonicity of G gives a strict lower bound on X_I; the susceptible-prey balance then yields the stated necessary inequality. Exact rational substitution of the Section 7.2 values produces the negative margin -1156/6525, so the contradiction is rigorous and parameter-wide rather than numerical.

value.rationale: The result is a structural, delay-independent positive-coexistence exclusion test. At the paper's principal Section 7.2 example it proves the entire positive equilibrium set empty, so the reported local-stability and Hopf scenario lacks its required base equilibrium. This is materially stronger and more useful than recomputing a single coordinate residual.
